description: Sample and hold with a clock of its own that reaches audio rate, and an eight-step switch deciding which ticks fire

params.text: Sets the sampling rate of the internal clock, from 1Hz up to well past audio rate
Tunes the internal clock over one octave above whatever RATE sets
Picks whether the internal clock times the sampling, or the CLOCK/SYNC input does
Picks what that step does: On fires a sample, Off skips it, and Reset ends the pattern there so the sequence restarts from step 1

inputs.text: In external mode a rising edge here takes a sample; in internal mode it resets the internal clock's phase, hard-syncing it. It reads high above 2V and low below 0.1V
Volt-per-octave control of the internal clock rate, added to the RATE and FINE knobs
A rising edge here takes a sample outside the clock's own timing, reading high above 2V and low below 0.1V

outputs.text: A 10V square wave at the internal clock rate, at 50% duty
A trigger on each step switched On, at 50% duty when internally clocked and a short pulse when externally clocked
The input sampled and held at each firing step, holding its value until the next one

menu: Remove DC Offset — centres the clock and trigger outputs on 0V instead of running them from 0V upwards; on by default

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
